000.$description: Used by: light bg.page (Sampled), light surface.card (Sampled).

350.$description: Used by: light surface.bubble (Sampled), light surface.tab (Sampled).

1150.$description: Used by: dark border.settings (Sampled (text)), dark surface.glass (Sampled).

1400.$description: Used by: dark border.divider (Sampled (text)), dark surface.bubble (Sampled).

1700.$description: Used by: dark bg.sidebar (Sampled), dark surface.tableHeader (Sampled).

control.$description: Outlined buttons and selects in Settings (Connect, Off): 3.4pt and 3.4pt dark, 3.4pt light. Plus or minus 2 pt.

frame.$description: Inline database frame (6.8pt dark, 6.8pt light) and its blue + split button (6.8pt dark, 6.8pt light). Plus or minus 2 pt.

card.$description: Grouped cards in a large sheet (Actions, Theme): 10.2pt dark, 10.2pt light; the segmented font card 11.9pt dark, 13.7pt light; the outlined result card in an AI answer 8.5pt dark, 10.2pt light. Plus or minus 2 pt.

composer.$description: The expanded AI composer: 20.5pt dark, 18.8pt light.

bubble.$description: The owner's message bubble in an AI chat: 22.2pt dark, 22.2pt light. All four corners are the same.

list.$description: The inset grouped list inside a small sheet (Sort): 25.6pt, the system's own list style, larger than Notion's cards.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a sheet: 35.8pt dark, 35.8pt light.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the top tabs, the bottom-bar pill and buttons, the + Chat button, the view chip (15.4pt dark, 15.4pt light on a 33 pt chip), switches and the send button.

base.$description: Most measured gaps are multiples of 4 pt within a point.

xs.$description: Gap between a row icon and the edge of its tile.

sm.$description: Gap between the top tabs (408 - 392 px = 8 pt in 01-home-sidebar-tree) and between the bottom-bar buttons.

md.$description: Gap between an icon and its label in rows and tabs.

lg.$description: Side margin of grouped cards in sheets (the Actions cards start at x 48, (48 - 16) / 2 = 16 pt).

xl.$description: Text margin of the sidebar and lists: section headers and rows start 21 pt from the edge; settings text 19 pt.

page.$description: Text margin of a page: body text starts 27 pt from the edge, wider than the sidebar's.

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of text in the sidebar, Chats, Inbox and Settings.

row.$description: Single-line row in the sidebar and the Chats list: the line pitch of their titles, 44.2pt and 44.0pt.

rowSheet.$description: Single-line row in a grouped card in a sheet (Actions, Filters): 45.0pt divider to divider.

rowSearch.$description: Two-line search result (title and location): 62.8pt pitch.

rowDatabase.$description: Row in a database list view (coloured groups): 40.2pt pitch, with a 2 pt gap between rows.

tab.$description: Height of the top tabs. Unselected tabs are circles about 54 pt wide; the selected one grows into a pill with its label (119.5 pt for Home).

avatarButton.$description: The round account button left of the tabs (45pt dark, 46pt light).

barButton.$description: Round glass buttons in the bottom bar (search, compose): 49pt dark, 50pt light.

barPill.$description: Height of the bottom bar's 'Ask AI' glass pill (48pt dark, 49pt light); it fills the width between the two buttons (215 pt).

navButton.$description: Round glass buttons on the AI chat (history, new chat) and sheet close buttons.

composer.$description: The AI composer while focused: a two-row glass card (85pt dark, 86pt light), text above, tools below.

composerCompact.$description: The AI composer when not focused: one capsule row with + and the mic.

sendButton.$description: The blue round send button in the composer (32x32pt).

control.$description: Outlined buttons and selects in Settings (Connect 28pt, Off 28pt).

controlLarge.$description: The wide select on its own line in Settings (Theme).

splitButton.$description: The blue + split button on a database (60x31.5pt).

radio.$description: Radio outer diameter (Sort): a ring when off, a blue ring with a dark centre when on.

touchTarget.$description: Tabs, rows and bar buttons are 44 pt or more. The Settings controls (28 pt) and the split button (31.5 pt) are smaller and sit in taller rows.

hairline.$description: Dividers and rims: two device pixels at 2x, so 1 pt (border.divider reads a two-pixel row in 19-page-actions-sheet).

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms are a neo-grotesque close to the iOS system face; the Actions sheet offers Default, Serif and Mono for a page. Use the platform font.

regular.$description: Rows, body text, subtitles, menu items. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Tab labels and the + Chat label. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Nav and sheet titles, the settings section title. Judged by stroke width.

bold.$description: Page titles and headings. Judged by stroke width.

pageTitle.$description: Page title under the icon (Databases (Engine)). Cap-height readings: 33pt.

heading1.$description: Heading 1 in a page. Cap-height readings: 29pt.

heading2.$description: Heading 2 in a page. Cap-height readings: 23pt.

title.$description: Section title in Settings (Notifications, Preferences). Cap-height readings: 20pt.

bodyLarge.$description: Sidebar, Chats and sheet rows, the owner's bubble, AI answers, menu items, nav and sheet titles (titles semibold). Cap-height readings: 17pt.

button.$description: The + Chat button label. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

body.$description: Page body text, on a 24 pt line. Cap-height readings: 16pt.

callout.$description: Tab labels, the composer placeholder, model picker items, small sheet titles. Cap-height readings: 16pt.

subheadline.$description: Sidebar section headers, settings row titles, empty-state lines, Settings controls, dates, Done. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

footnote.$description: Settings subtitles and segment labels, on an 18 pt line. Cap-height readings: 13pt.

caption.$description: Search result locations, menu headers and descriptions, table headers. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (tabs, bottom bar, composer, menus, nav buttons): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: none drawn under cards; glass controls carry the system's own soft shadow
Inline code corner radius: too small to read off the captures
Line heights of titles and one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured

sidebar.$description: Home (the sidebar tree), the Chats, Meetings and Inbox tabs, Settings and the bar behind search.

page.$description: Pages, the AI chat and search results: the canvas content sits on.

sheet.$description: Small sheets (search Filters, Sort): the page colour.

sheetGrouped.$description: Large sheets with grouped cards (page Actions, Theme, Views): the sidebar colour.

scrim.$description: Black at 20%: the search canvas reads #FFFFFF undimmed and #CCCCCC under the Filters sheet. A pushed card (the AI chat) dims the sidebar above it to #C9C5C6.

card.$description: Grouped cards in a large sheet (Actions, Theme, Views). White on the off-white sheet in light.

list.$description: The system's inset grouped list inside a small sheet (Sort). Not captured in light: filled from bg.sidebar, the grey the light theme uses for raised rows (table header, large sheet).

tableHeader.$description: Table header row in a page.

bubble.$description: The owner's message bubble in an AI chat: a quiet grey, never the accent.

code.$description: Inline code behind red monospace text.

tab.$description: Unselected top tabs (Chats, Meetings, Inbox as circles).

tabSelected.$description: The selected top tab, a pill holding its icon and label. The box's dominant colour covers 85% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

glass.$description: Glass controls (the search bar, nav buttons), centre reading. The material tints with whatever is behind it. The box's dominant colour covers 80% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

menu.$description: Pop-up menus (glass, model picker). Over content the reading shifts with what is behind.

chip.$description: Database view chip ('Areas'). The box's dominant colour covers 50% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

iconTile.$description: Square tile behind a teamspace icon. The box's dominant colour covers 83% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

grabber.$description: Sheet grabber. The box's dominant colour covers 42% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

blue.$description: Database group background, blue. Rows in the group sit on it with primary text.

divider.$description: Hairline between rows of a grouped card, full width of the card. The hairline's lightest pixel in dark, darkest in light.

separator.$description: Hairline between settings rows, inset to the text margin. The hairline's lightest pixel in dark, darkest in light.

control.$description: Rim of outlined buttons and selects in Settings (Connect, Off). The hairline's lightest pixel in dark, darkest in light.

card.$description: Rim of an outlined card (the result card in an AI answer). The hairline's lightest pixel in dark, darkest in light.

table.$description: Table rim and cell lines in a page. The hairline's lightest pixel in dark, darkest in light.

frame.$description: Rim of an inline database. The hairline's lightest pixel in dark, darkest in light.

primary.$description: Titles, sidebar and sheet rows, page text, settings rows (page body reads #2B2B2B, settings rows #2C2A2A).

prose.$description: AI answers, the owner's bubble, Inbox bodies and small sheet titles: softer than primary in dark (bubble #312F2C, inbox #302F2C, sheet title #312F2D).

secondary.$description: Section headers, subtitles, empty states, the bar's 'Ask AI'. Readings in this role: #7B7976, #7C7877, #7D7977, #7E7976.

tertiary.$description: Dates, row values, footnotes (Sort value reads #A09F9B).

placeholder.$description: Composer placeholder (the property search placeholder reads #B0B0B0).

menu.$description: Items in a system pop-up menu: near-white or near-black, not Notion's warm ink.

danger.$description: Destructive rows (Move to Bin): red text and a red icon, never a red fill.

accent.$description: Active controls in text: an applied sort or filter, Done, the selected font ('Ag' reads #2482DC).

onAccent.$description: Label and glyph on a blue button.

icon.$description: Row icons in sheets: the primary ink.

iconMuted.$description: Unselected tab icons and the bar's glyphs.

default.$description: Notion blue: the database + button, the selected radio, the send button.

button.$description: The floating + Chat button (glass over blue), centre reading.

caret.$description: Text caret in a focused field: the only focus indicator (no ring). The box's dominant colour covers 17% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

border.$description: Outlined button (Connect, Manage settings): no fill, a hairline rim.

off.$description: Switch off track in native sheets (search Filters, Actions).

offSettings.$description: Switch off track in Settings: a warmer grey than the native sheets'.

on.$description: Selected radio: a blue ring around a dark centre.

off.$description: Unselected radio ring. Not captured in light: filled from text.secondary, the closest light role.

danger.$description: Danger: red text on destructive rows. No danger fill was seen.

unread.$description: The dot on the account button for unread activity (salmon in dark, red in light). The box's dominant colour covers 37% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

notTokenised: Success and warning colours: no such state was seen
The other database and select colours (grey, brown, yellow, purple, red): only blue, green, pink and orange groups were on screen
